description: Schema for block-text tool calling format. Avoids JSON escaping issues with code content.
instructions: Output your reasoning in [THOUGHT]...[/THOUGHT] blocks, then invoke tools using [tool_name]...[/tool_name] format wrapped in <tool_code> tags.

format.tool_block:
<tool_code>
[tool_name]
param: value
content:
multiline content here
[/tool_name]
</tool_code>

search.description: Search for a pattern in files using grep

write_file.description: Write content to a file. WARNING: Output FULL file content, no placeholders or truncation.

apply_patch.description: Apply a git-format patch. Prefer this over write_file for small changes to existing files.
apply_patch.example:
[apply_patch]
patch:
--- a/src/main.js
+++ b/src/main.js
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+import { test } from './utils';
 const x = 1;
[/apply_patch]

done.description: Signal that the spec is complete. Call this when you have verified everything works.
done.example:
[done]
summary: Implemented login feature with validation and tests passing
[/done]
